description: Grade a host's transport security A–F in one call, correlating tls_certificate (validity, chain trust, protocol, key/signature), cert_revocation (OCSP/CRL endpoints, must-staple) and hsts_preload_check (browser HSTS preload). Returns the letter grade, a 0–100 score, and the factors behind it (expired/weak-key/obsolete-protocol lower it; must-staple and HSTS preload strengthen it). A benign TLS handshake plus a keyless HSTS lookup — no probing. Read-only.

host.description: Host name or IP, e.g. example.com

name: tls_posture
